title: The Dudleys challenge the Eliminators
summary: Buh Buh Ray and D-Von become a serious championship team by taking on Saturn and Kronus. Their first title exchange places ECW’s tag division prominently on its pay-per-view debut.

chapters.title: The Dudleys win their first titles
chapters.result: The Dudley Boyz defeat the Eliminators for the tag championships.
chapters.context: The newly established duo becomes the team to beat.

chapters.title: The Eliminators regain the belts
chapters.result: Saturn and Kronus defeat the Dudleys for the championships.
chapters.context: The challengers reclaim the titles in the opening match of ECW’s first pay-per-view.
